votes.motion: Commissioner Nixon moved to APPROVE the Planning Commission Minutes for October 12, 2023
Commissioner Fowler moved to APPROVE the Planning Commission Meeting Dates for 2024, as presented

Commissioner Fowler moved to APPROVE the site plan extension as requested by David Tillotson, representing IKON Development for Trailside Townhomes, Application SPR- 058-2022, based on the request by the original applicant and the following: Finding: 1. The applicant has shown good cause to obtain an extension and that substantial action has occurred towards obtaining a Land Disturbance Permit

Commissioner Squire moved to APPROVE the Home Occupation Conditional Use Permit as requested by Ambyr T. Lindsay representing Ambyr T. Lindsay, Inc. Ambyr Lindsay, Terry Young, and Laurie Young for a Home Occupation Conditional Use Permit, Application HOCC-6837-2023 based on the following: Conditions: 1. All requirements of the Draper City Engineering, Public Works, Building, Planning, and Fire Divisions are satisfied throughout the development of the site and the construction on the site, including permitting. 2. The days of operation shall be limited as proposed by the applicant to three day
Commissioner Fowler moved to ADJOURN. Vote: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Commission. The meeting adjourned at 7:59 PM
